meta.title: Eco-Rating Core Criteria
meta.subtitle: The 37 mandatory questions that define baseline certification eligibility
meta.source: Green Key Global Eco-Rating Core Criteria, June 2026
meta.sourceNote: Question wording, answer options, and requirements are periodically revised by Green Key Global. The live self-assessment portal and greenkeyglobal.com are the source of record.
meta.scoringNote: This reference shows what each question asks and what documentation it requires. It does not show scoring. Scoring detail is available inside the self-assessment portal.

sections.label: Corporate
sections.description: Policies, governance, and the Green Team

questions.question: Does your hotel have a written sustainability policy (or set of policies) in place?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: Has the sustainability policy been endorsed (approved and signed) by a hotel senior corporate officer?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: Is a senior manager or officer accountable for monitoring policy implementation, to ensure hotel operations align with the sustainability policy?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: Is the sustainability policy communicated to all members of the organization?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: The hotel-wide sustainability policy includes a commitment to addressing the following.
questions.requirement: Must select all options flagged mandatory, plus any others that apply.

questions.question: Does the policy or set of policies cover a long-term approach, and has the policy been developed suitable to the hotel's size and scope of services?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: Does a written management action plan exist that addresses policy commitments?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: When was the written management action plan last reviewed or revised?
questions.requirement: The implemented plan must have been reviewed within the past 12 months.

questions.question: The hotel's written management action plan includes the following.
questions.requirement: Must select all options flagged mandatory, plus any others that apply.

questions.question: Does the hotel have a written responsible purchasing policy that prioritizes the following elements?
questions.requirement: Must select all options flagged mandatory, plus any others that apply.
mandatoryElements: Eco-friendly products (cleaning supplies, amenities, and similar)
Certified responsible or green products (fair trade, organic, and similar)
Local, eco-friendly, or certified responsible suppliers

questions.question: Has a Green Team been assigned responsibility for directing and coordinating environmental initiatives?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: The Green Team is comprised of the following.
questions.requirement: Must select at least one option. At minimum, one environmental coordinator or champion.

questions.question: Does the hotel's Green Team have a written mandate with support from senior management?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: Does the hotel's Green Team meet at least quarterly?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes. The audit looks for evidence of actual meetings, not only a signed mandate.

questions.question: Which paper conservation initiatives are in place in offices and administration areas?
questions.requirement: Must select all options flagged mandatory, plus any others that apply.
mandatoryElements: Guest folios are emailed rather than printed

questions.question: Is there a formal program in place which allows guests to opt out of housekeeping, for example reusing linens or towels?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes. An informal practice is not sufficient. Put the opt-out mechanics in writing and in the room.

questions.question: Are standard set-points used for all guest room thermostats and communicated to Housekeeping staff?
questions.requirement: Must select the option flagged mandatory. An N/A option exists for properties without HVAC or with open-air buildings.
mandatoryElements: Set point relevant to the region's climate

questions.question: Are housekeeping staff trained to use natural light when cleaning guestrooms?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: When leaving guestrooms, are housekeeping staff trained to open or close blinds and drapes according to the heating and cooling needs of the room?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: Are housekeepers trained to ensure windows and external doors are closed when heating or cooling systems are in use?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes. An N/A option exists for properties without HVAC or with open-air buildings.

questions.question: Are housekeepers trained to check that lights, radios, and televisions are turned off in unoccupied rooms?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: What percentage of cleaning products are eco-friendly (biodegradable, vegetable-based, non-toxic alternatives, or third-party certified)?
questions.requirement: Must select the option that reflects actual practice. This question is graduated, so partial conversion is recorded as partial coverage.

questions.question: Do you have a policy and procedure in place concerning the proper handling and disposal of cleaning supplies and medical waste, such as cleaning chemicals, needles, and medications?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.
questions.uploadDocument: Cleaning supplies and medical waste disposal policy

questions.question: Are housekeeping staff trained to minimize water use when cleaning?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: Are housekeepers trained to report faulty equipment to the Maintenance department, for example windows that do not close, broken lights, running toilets, or dripping faucets?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: Are annual use and costs of electricity being measured and tracked?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes and upload supporting documents.
questions.note: The EPA ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager is a free tool for tracking energy, water, waste, and emissions, and produces records of this kind.

questions.question: Are annual use and costs of natural gas being measured and tracked?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes and upload supporting documents. An N/A option exists if natural gas is not used at the property.
questions.uploadDocument: Natural gas use and cost records

questions.question: Are annual use and costs of water being measured and tracked?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes and upload supporting documents.

questions.question: Is there a regularly scheduled preventative maintenance program in place that ensures routine maintenance and adjustments are made to the following?
questions.requirement: Must select all options flagged mandatory and upload the maintenance program.

questions.question: Rather than running HVAC systems continuously, which of the following practices or modifications have been made to improve energy efficiency?
questions.requirement: Must select all options flagged mandatory, plus any others that apply.

questions.question: Which of the following insulation measures have been taken?
questions.requirement: Must select all options flagged mandatory, plus any others that apply. An N/A option exists where climate does not support the need for such measures.
mandatoryElements: All doors and windows are properly weather stripped or caulked
Entry doors are revolving or kept closed

questions.question: Which of the following features have been installed on windows to reduce solar energy gains?
questions.requirement: Must select all options flagged mandatory, plus any others that apply. An N/A option exists for climates where solar gain supports heating requirements.

questions.question: Which of the following are used for outdoor lighting, including building exterior, signage, parking garage, and security lighting?
questions.requirement: Must select all options flagged mandatory, plus any others that apply.

questions.question: Is energy efficiency taken into consideration when purchasing new appliances and equipment, for example ENERGY STAR certified, EnerGuide ratings, or EU Energy Label?
questions.requirement: Must answer Yes.

questions.question: What percentage of guestrooms have been equipped with low-flow showerheads?
questions.requirement: Must select the option that reflects actual coverage. This question is graduated, so partial conversion is recorded as partial coverage.
questions.note: Coverage is assessed across the guestroom count, so a partial conversion program leaves the remainder unanswered.

questions.question: What percentage of guestrooms have been equipped with tap aerators?
questions.requirement: Must select the option that reflects actual coverage. This question is graduated, so partial conversion is recorded as partial coverage.

questions.question: What percentage of guestrooms have been equipped with low-flow toilets, dual-flush toilets, toilet dams, or tank fill diverters?
questions.requirement: Must select the option that reflects actual coverage. This question is graduated, so partial conversion is recorded as partial coverage.
